scope: One bounded research candidate; neutral point edits only; no app settings/UI/history/MCP/export enablement.

sourcePin.license: MIT notice retained; no Halide runtime dependency or code bundled into production

algorithm.boundary: Clamp each finite intermediate level; ceil-half dimensions. Explicit research adaptation, not virtual-source-edge Halide parity.
algorithm.downsample: Separable Y then X, [1,3,3,1]/8 at2p+[-1,0,1,2]; centered-difference arithmetic preserves constants.
algorithm.feature: L=asinh(Y/0.18), actual srgb/rec2020 primary-derived coefficients; source |L|<=6 or explicit refusal; no exposure normalization/clamp
algorithm.alpha: Gaussian pair stores weighted numerator and alpha weight; normalize at coefficient/upsample reads, emptyweight=>0; transparent input ignored and RGB/alpha words retained
algorithm.coefficient: norm(F_j)-norm(U(F_j+1)), interpolate adjacent g using normalized source G_j, only j1/2; store weighted delta numerator and G_j.alphaWeight
algorithm.reconstruct: R1=(norm(D1)+norm(U(D2)))*G1.alphaWeight, normalized weighted upsample R1 to full grid
algorithm.composite: RGBout=RGBsource+coverage*luminanceDelta; coverage AFTER nonlinear reconstruction; alpha unchanged; amount0/mask0/alpha0 exact source copy
algorithm.order: Each active mask can materialize preceding Float32 result before next source preparation; no general active global/local point-edit integration claimed.
algorithm.tiling: Full-frame research buffers, no invented three-strip/composed-halo claim; full integration and tiled execution remain unqualified

gates.photo: Useful modest texture/softening in fixed native views; no material new halo/grain/mask seam/coarse contrast shift; exact unmasked working bytes vs original prepared source and original production proof pixels. Unseen or general quality not claimed.

preparation: Existing production full-native prepareLinear and GPU SDR proof; AsShot/neutral curves Light Color WB, no lens/crop/local edits. Preserve raster linear-sRGB/transform and merge scene-linear Rec2020.

runtime.backend: Existing isolated native Dawn device, no CPU feature fallback/retry
runtime.budget: Unchanged Automatic RAM and conservative unmatched-adapter2GiB VRAM, all allocated buffers and managed host frames admitted before work
runtime.resourceFailure: Explicit refusal, no lower resolution or equivalent CPU restart

stop: Stop on first numerical/resource/quality failure; inspect exact failure and correct implementation defects only. No result-driven algorithm/strength/mask/source tuning or automatic candidate cycle. Skin/foliage only after useful flamingo review.
